Heavy.com has written about him amid trade market talk. After the rout of Chicago, North State Journal's Cory Lavalette posted him saying: "Just need to realize sometimes it's not always about you." Meanwhile he has 10 points in 17 games, already more than his 9 in 42 last season, while playing under 12 minutes a night with no power-play time.

Most of it is luck, and the numbers say so plainly. He has 5 goals on 1.8 expected (expected goals measure the quality of chances), shooting 25% against 5% last season, and Carolina has scored 4.9 more goals than expected with him on the ice. Evolving-Hockey's note on last season fits: his results ran ahead of his chances, and his strong teammates flatter his on-ice numbers.

The 2018 third overall pick, signed away from Montreal by offer sheet in 2021 and a Stanley Cup winner last spring, is still best at keeping chances against down. That is the version to expect once the shooting cools, and it is a useful one in a depth role, trade talk or not.
headline: Kotkaniemi is scoring through the trade talk
